CREATE TABLE blocks (
    block_code text PRIMARY KEY,
    planted_year integer,
    replanted boolean
);

First 2 rows:
block_code  planted_year  replanted
B-01        2011          False
B-02        2015          True

CREATE TABLE harvest (
    harvest_id integer PRIMARY KEY,
    block_code text REFERENCES blocks (block_code),
    season integer,
    weight_kg numeric
);

First 2 rows:
harvest_id  block_code  season  weight_kg
1           B-01        2025    1820.5
2           B-02        2025    944.0
